author: Koteswara Rao
title: Unusual curling in Teja Chilli variety
content: My Chilli crops in Guntur are showing leaf curl symptoms. I suspect thrips infestation due to dry weather. Let me know if anyone else is facing this and what pesticide/biological control worked best.

author: Anila Devi
title: Paddy transplantation water level query
content: We transplanted Paddy last week in Nellore. Current water levels are about 4cm. Should I let it dry out a bit or maintain this level throughout the tillering stage? Standard advice says 2-5cm, looking for practical local experiences.

author: Bhaskar Reddy
title: Onion yard pricing trends this week
content: Onion yields look decent in Kurnool this season. Mandi prices are hovering around ₹1,400 per quintal. Anyone seeing better rates in Guntur or Krishna markets?
